caption: The drawing depicts a piece of rectangular, slightly irregular fabric set against a plain, off-white background. The fabric is primarily purple and has a textured or patterned surface featuring light, curving lines and shapes in various shades of purple and white. On the purple fabric are three evenly spaced floral designs, each consisting of a black center with surrounding yellow and black petal shapes. The fabric appears to have frayed edges, especially along the top and bottom, and the overall composition is centered on the page with the fabric oriented diagonally. In the bottom right corner of the page, small handwritten text is visible.
title: Ribbon
